newsitem.title: USA: USA Waste completes Sanifill acquisition.
newsitem.headline: USA Waste completes Sanifill acquisition.

text.p: USA Waste Services Inc said Tuesday it has completed the acquisition of Sanifill Inc.

In support of the merger, USA Waste said, it has arranged a $1.2 billion five-year revolving credit agreement with a group of 30 banks led by Bank of America, Bank of Boston and Morgan Guaranty Trust Co.
In addition to improved terms and reduced borrowing costs, the facility will be available for working capital requirements and future acquisitions.
On August 30, USA Waste said, it entered into a consent decree with the U.S. Department of Justice to resolve certain anti-trust issues and obtain clearance to complete the merger.

The requirements related to the consent decree will not change the synergies initially estimated related to the merger or have a material impact on operations, the company said without providing any details.
